description: Search FCC regulatory proceedings and rulemaking dockets from the Electronic Comment Filing System (ECFS). Returns docket numbers, descriptions, bureaus, filing counts, and dates. Use to research telecom regulatory actions on topics like net neutrality, spectrum allocation, broadband deployment, and consumer protection. Filter by bureau (WC, MB, WTB, OET) or keyword.

bureau.description: FCC bureau code to filter by (e.g. "WC" Wireline, "MB" Media, "WTB" Wireless, "OET" Engineering).

limit.description: Number of proceedings to return (default 10, max 25).

q.description: Free-text search query across proceeding descriptions (e.g. "net neutrality", "broadband", "spectrum").

sort.description: Sort field and direction (e.g. "date_proceeding_created,DESC" or "total_filing_count,DESC"). Default: newest first.

name: fcc.regulatory.search_proceedings

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: FCC Regulatory Proceedings Search
